page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-4x.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for compute-intensive workloads requiring parallel processing capabilities. Powered by the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 64 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The primary hardware accelerator configuration consists of four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of GDDR6 VRAM. This multi-GPU setup is suited for deep learning inference, mid-range AI model training, high-density video transcoding, and 3D rendering. The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfers between the instance and external storage or distributed nodes.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn7i-4x.16xlarge offers a balanced mid-tier GPU alternative to high-end accelerator instances. By utilizing NVIDIA A10 GPUs, it provides substantial parallel computing power and VRAM density without the premium cost associated with flagship enterprise GPUs. This makes it a practical choice for organizations running scaled inference workloads, media processing pipelines, and parallelized scientific simulations that require multi-GPU configurations but do not demand the extreme memory bandwidth of top-tier accelerators.
